name: Jaggedswine Farm
summary: South of Orgrimmar's main gate, Jaggedswine Farm raises swine for the capital. Its shed, pen, and watering hole serve the Horde's nearby stronghold.

sections.title: Provisions for the Capital
sections.body: Jaggedswine Farm shows the harsh work of feeding an urban stronghold like Orgrimmar. Durotar's red soil supports little farming, so hardy livestock helps feed the city's warriors and laborers. A timber storehouse, a broad wooden pen, and a natural watering hole anchor the farm. Swine are herded, bred, and butchered here to keep the Horde's granaries supplied.

sections.title: A Quiet Frontier
sections.body: Swineherds and patrolling Orgrimmar Grunts visit the farm, though the dry heat can leave it looking half-tended. Wild and mature swine roam inside and beyond the enclosures, sometimes testing nearby guards. The farm stands at the edge of the valley approach to the capital, an unassuming but necessary part of Durotar's daily supply work.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Jaggedswine Farm?
aliases: why is there a pig farm in durotar
faq.answer: Jaggedswine Farm raises swine for meat and lard, feeding the people and garrison of nearby Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where exactly is Jaggedswine Farm located?
aliases: how to get to jaggedswine farm
faq.answer: Jaggedswine Farm lies in northern Durotar, just outside the southern approach and grand gates leading into Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

faq.q: Why does the farm look somewhat deserted?
faq.answer: Orcish livestock farming in Durotar is utilitarian and unglamorous. Free-roaming boars and sparse timber buildings leave the farm without grand homesteads, but Horde supply lines still use it.

faq.q: Are the pigs here dangerous to travelers?
faq.answer: The domesticated swine inside the pens are docile, but wild and mature boars on the outskirts can turn aggressive if startled by young travelers or careless foragers.

angles.text: As a Horde cook learning the trade in Durotar, you can find tender ribs, pork cuts, and cooking grease among the swine raised around Jaggedswine Farm, a primary local source.
As a member of the Horde, you know stable meat supplies in Durotar's arid wastes mean survival. Jaggedswine Farm helps sustain Orgrimmar's military strength.
